title: Syntax — quick overview
rememberThis: No ASI; if() needs bool; switch does not fall through without goto case.

C# 11 raw strings; C# 14 null-conditional assignment and nameof(List<>).

bullets: Integer division truncates; money literals use m.
?? and ?. skip work; ?. = skips RHS when receiver is null.
